name: AgentGuard Security
description: Evaluates OpenClaw tool calls and outbound messages through AgentGuard Guard API.

guardApiBaseUrl.description: Guard API URL. HTTP is allowed only for explicit loopback addresses; remote targets require HTTPS and redirects are rejected.

strongApprovalBindingEnabled.description: Deprecated legacy canary flag; defaults to false in the config builder. Do not combine with V2 options. C3 remains false; server-declared execution leases still fail closed.

officialProfileId.description: Trusted V2 profile metadata, paired with officialProfileDigest, productManifestPath and runtimeBindingId in enforce mode. Plugin activation remains unavailable until durable delivery, breaker and seven event consumers are complete.

officialProfileDigest.description: Trusted canonical SHA-256 digest of the official profile; never learned from the evaluation response.

restrictedAskReleaseEnabled.description: Experimental restricted ASK release; defaults to false in the config builder. Enabling is not available in this reader-only build. C3 remains false.

activationAckMaxAgeMs.description: Maximum ActivationAckV1 age in milliseconds; defaults to 120000 in the config builder. Does not extend server expiry.

runtimeBindingId.description: Trusted runtime binding identifier provisioned with this OpenClaw adapter. It must exactly match a server-declared strong binding.

productManifestPath.description: Absolute protected local Product manifest file (0600 in a 0700 directory). Activation transport requires this trusted identity and inventory; plugin registration remains unavailable until full Product composition.

productReceiptDirectory.description: Absolute private Product encrypted receipt directory. Requires productReceiptKeyPath outside this directory. Full Product registration remains unavailable.

productReceiptKeyPath.description: Absolute path for the separate 0600 Product AES-256-GCM key in a 0700 directory. Never place this key inside the receipt queue.

adapterToken.label: AgentGuard adapter token SecretRef
adapterToken.help: Use an OpenClaw SecretRef; plaintext tokens are not accepted.

strongApprovalBindingEnabled.label: Legacy canary flag (deprecated)
strongApprovalBindingEnabled.help: Deprecated; do not combine with V2 fields, including explicit false values. C3 remains false. Server-declared execution leases still fail closed.

officialProfileId.label: Official V2 profile ID
officialProfileId.help: Provision together with officialProfileDigest and runtimeBindingId in enforce mode. Activation is not available in this build; configured profiles refuse plugin registration rather than run legacy authority.

officialProfileDigest.label: Official V2 profile digest
officialProfileDigest.help: Provision a lowercase sha256 digest out of band; do not derive it from Guard API responses.

restrictedAskReleaseEnabled.label: Experimental restricted ASK release
restrictedAskReleaseEnabled.help: Defaults to false. Enabling is not available until durable delivery, breaker and runtime consumers are complete. C3 remains false.

activationAckMaxAgeMs.label: Activation ACK maximum age (ms)
activationAckMaxAgeMs.help: Integer from 1 to 120000; default 120000. Server expiry remains authoritative.

runtimeBindingId.label: Runtime binding ID
runtimeBindingId.help: Provision this value out of band. Missing or mismatched values fail closed for server-declared bindings.

productManifestPath.label: Protected Product manifest path
productManifestPath.help: Provision the manifest locally. Identity and inventory must never be inferred from Guard API output.

productReceiptDirectory.label: Product encrypted receipt directory
productReceiptDirectory.help: Provide an absolute private directory with a separate productReceiptKeyPath. No defaults or plaintext fallback; Product registration remains unavailable.

productReceiptKeyPath.label: Product receipt key path
productReceiptKeyPath.help: Provide an absolute 0600 key file outside the encrypted queue, in a 0700 directory. Keep the key for historical receipt recovery.
